# Privacy Policy

This is a starter template. Have it reviewed for your country before launch.

## What we collect

We do not require accounts. Ad partners may use cookies to show ads. You can choose generic ads in the consent banner.

## Contact

Write to the address shown in our takedown page.

pages.title: Takedown requests
pages.content:
# Takedown requests

If you are the author of a file listed here and want it removed, send us the link and proof of ownership. We remove confirmed requests promptly.
